inject_or_decision: Confirm the exercise scope, participating tenants, systems, and explicit out-of-scope boundaries
expected_action: Name the facilitator, observers, technical leads, business owners, legal or insurance contacts, and stop authority
evidence_to_capture: Approved scope, participant roster, contact tree, and stop conditions
pass_criteria: Every participant can state the scope, authority, and stop conditions

inject_or_decision: A production safety concern appears during the exercise
expected_action: Pause the exercise, separate simulated actions from live systems, and invoke the approved stop procedure
evidence_to_capture: Pause time, reason, affected system, decision, and approval to resume or end
pass_criteria: No participant performs an unapproved production action

inject_or_decision: The primary RMM console and normal collaboration channel are assumed unavailable
expected_action: Switch to the approved independent command channel and offline contact list
evidence_to_capture: Independent channel test, contact acknowledgements, and access result
pass_criteria: The team can coordinate without relying on the suspected platform

inject_or_decision: An alert reports a privileged RMM login from an unexpected location
expected_action: Validate the signal, open an incident record, record UTC time, and assign provisional severity
evidence_to_capture: Original alert, identity details, source, UTC timestamp, ticket, and severity rationale
pass_criteria: The original evidence is preserved before account or policy changes

inject_or_decision: A customer reports an unexplained remote session and command execution
expected_action: Correlate the customer report with session, audit, identity, endpoint, and network evidence
evidence_to_capture: Customer report, session record, endpoint identity, commands, actor, and correlation notes
pass_criteria: The team can distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions

inject_or_decision: The same account accessed multiple tenants during the previous hour
expected_action: Identify affected tenants, endpoints, automations, integrations, secrets, and customer boundaries
evidence_to_capture: Tenant and endpoint inventory, access timeline, automation history, and uncertainty list
pass_criteria: Scope includes known affected assets and explicitly tracked unknowns

inject_or_decision: Audit export is delayed or incomplete
expected_action: Preserve available logs, document the gap, request vendor evidence, and use independent telemetry
evidence_to_capture: Export request, failure details, alternate logs, retention risk, and escalation record
pass_criteria: Missing evidence is visible, owned, and does not silently narrow scope

inject_or_decision: The suspected account is still active and supports critical customer operations
expected_action: Choose a bounded containment action balancing active risk and service dependency
evidence_to_capture: Options considered, decision authority, affected services, approval, and rollback path
pass_criteria: Containment is authorized, recorded, reversible where possible, and time-bounded

inject_or_decision: A high-risk automation may still be queued across multiple tenants
expected_action: Pause or isolate the automation, preserve its definition and history, and verify queue state
evidence_to_capture: Automation export, queue state, target scope, pause action, and verification
pass_criteria: No new execution occurs while evidence remains preserved

inject_or_decision: Remote access remains available through a secondary integration
expected_action: Disable or restrict the integration, rotate exposed credentials, and validate revocation
evidence_to_capture: Integration inventory, credential actions, session termination, and validation results
pass_criteria: All identified remote paths are either contained or accepted by named authority

inject_or_decision: A responder proposes deleting suspicious artifacts to stop recurrence
expected_action: Preserve authorized forensic copies and metadata before removal or quarantine
evidence_to_capture: Hash, path, timestamps, collection method, custodian, and removal approval
pass_criteria: Evidence handling follows the approved procedure and preserves provenance

inject_or_decision: Endpoint clocks and RMM audit timestamps disagree
expected_action: Normalize the working timeline to UTC and record clock offsets and source confidence
evidence_to_capture: Source timestamps, offsets, normalization method, and confidence notes
pass_criteria: The timeline distinguishes observed time, normalized time, and uncertainty

inject_or_decision: A customer asks whether data was accessed or exfiltrated
expected_action: Provide confirmed facts, current uncertainty, actions underway, and the next update time
evidence_to_capture: Approved message, facts and unknowns, recipient, sender, and timestamp
pass_criteria: The message avoids unsupported conclusions and names the next update

inject_or_decision: A regulator, insurer, or law-enforcement contact may be required
expected_action: Escalate to authorized legal, insurance, and executive decision makers without improvising a notification
evidence_to_capture: Applicable contact path, decision record, notification owner, and deadline
pass_criteria: Notification decisions are made by authorized owners using applicable requirements

inject_or_decision: Social media references the incident before customer notification is complete
expected_action: Activate the approved external-communications path and preserve public claims as evidence
evidence_to_capture: Public post capture, approved response, audience, timing, and escalation
pass_criteria: Only authorized spokespeople communicate externally

inject_or_decision: A script was modified shortly before the first known suspicious execution
expected_action: Compare versions, identify the editor and approval trail, and map every target and result
evidence_to_capture: Script versions, hashes, editor, approvals, targets, execution results, and timeline
pass_criteria: The team can explain what changed, who changed it, where it ran, and what happened

inject_or_decision: An API token used by an integration cannot be attributed to a person
expected_action: Identify ownership, permissions, creation history, usage, storage, and rotation dependencies
evidence_to_capture: Token metadata, permissions, owner, usage logs, dependent systems, and rotation plan
pass_criteria: Every privileged token has an accountable owner or is revoked

inject_or_decision: The business asks to restore console access before scope is complete
expected_action: Define minimum recovery conditions, compensating controls, approver, monitoring, and rollback
evidence_to_capture: Recovery criteria, approval, restricted roles, monitoring plan, and rollback trigger
pass_criteria: Access resumes only after named criteria and approval are satisfied

inject_or_decision: A pilot group is ready for restored automation
expected_action: Restore in a bounded wave, verify expected behavior, and watch for recurrence before expansion
evidence_to_capture: Pilot inventory, change record, success criteria, telemetry, result, and expansion decision
pass_criteria: The pilot passes measurable technical and operational checks

inject_or_decision: Endpoint inventory differs from the pre-incident baseline
expected_action: Reconcile enrolled, offline, duplicate, removed, and unexpected endpoints before closure
evidence_to_capture: Baseline, current inventory, variance list, owner, disposition, and evidence
pass_criteria: Every variance is explained, accepted, remediated, or assigned

inject_or_decision: Rotated credentials break a critical integration
expected_action: Use the approved recovery path without restoring compromised secrets or bypassing controls
evidence_to_capture: Failure evidence, dependency map, recovery action, new credential owner, and validation
pass_criteria: Service is restored with new authorized credentials and verified logging

inject_or_decision: The incident commander proposes closure while two corrective actions remain open
expected_action: Separate operational recovery from final closure and assign owners, dates, evidence, and review authority
evidence_to_capture: Open-action register, risk acceptance, owners, deadlines, and closure decision
pass_criteria: No unresolved risk disappears merely because service is restored

inject_or_decision: Participants disagree about whether the exercise met its objectives
expected_action: Score each objective against observed evidence, record gaps, and avoid consensus-only passing grades
evidence_to_capture: Objective scorecard, evidence references, disagreements, and final rationale
pass_criteria: Every pass or fail is supported by an observable record

inject_or_decision: A repeat exercise is required after corrective actions
expected_action: Define the retest scope, success criteria, owner, due date, and evidence needed to close each gap
evidence_to_capture: Corrective-action plan, retest date, scenarios, owners, and closure evidence
pass_criteria: Material gaps receive a scheduled retest and independent verification
